fragments.text: Hello, my name is Camille Stewart Glopster, and I am the CEO of CAS Strategies and Emerging Technology and Cybersecurity firm in the United States. I had the honor of serving as the first Deputy National Cyber Director, focused on technology and ecosystem security at the White House under President Biden and Vice President Harris. In that role, I was tasked to focus on emerging technologies like AI and quantum and the convergence of those. Supply chain security, privacy, human rights and technology, cyber workforce. The portfolio is very future resilience focused. We painted an affirmative vision for what we want a future digital ecosystem to look like. It would be values aligned and something we all can share and be secure,

And so through that lens and my experience in industry and academia, I think about how we can make sure that AI innovation is working for us and we're doing a lot of that work.
